messages:
Priya (CS): Planning a focused 30m enablement for Voltix (renewal check + onboarding blockers). Proposed: Tue 11:0011:30 PT. Can we keep it compact?

Sam: I can host. Recommend: 5m context, 12m checklist, 8m risk/runbook, 5m actions. No heavy demo.

Nina: Ill prepare the renewal health mini-slide (usage delta + errors + NPS blip). Will call out any rollout blockers.

Priya (CS): Great. Need someone to create invite + attach agenda template, and set a 24h pre-read reminder. @onboarding-bot?

onboarding-bot: Event created: https://cal.example.com/event/5345678901. Agenda template attached and reminder set.

Sam: Added a short "must-resolve" checklist to the doc. Can we get the customer to confirm the DB migration window before the meeting?

Priya (CS): I'll ping the customer now with a one-line ask. Nina, please post the 3-bullet pre-read by Monday EOD.

Nina: Will do. Notes volunteer?

Sam: I can take notes and push tasks to our tracker after the call.

Priya (CS): Perfect. Summary: onboarding-bot -> invite (done), Nina -> pre-read (Mon EOD), Sam -> notes & tasks. Posting final invite in the channel shortly. :white_check_mark:
